rows.english: Higher quality usually makes a larger file. Lossless keeps every colour value.
rows.raw: Yanggin mås måolik i kualidåt, sessu mås dångkulu i dokumentu. An ma\'usa lossless, mapo\'lu sin tinilaika kada numiru ni ma\'usa para i kulot gi pinenta.
rows.display: Yanggin mås måolik i kualidåt, sessu mås dångkulu i dokumentu. An ma'usa lossless, mapo'lu sin tinilaika kada numiru ni ma'usa para i kulot gi pinenta.
rows.backtranslation: If quality is better, the file is often larger. When lossless is used, every number used for colour in the image is retained without alteration.
rows.caller_summary: SaveOptionsDialog95–105 chooses this explanation for JPEG XL/WebP/AVIF and PNG, but hides the PNG explanation. ImageExporter passes quality/lossless to those encoders. HeifCodec91–95 specifically documents opaque RGB lossless AVIF. This description concerns the opaque editable image and does not make metadata, alpha-channel or file-byte equality claims.

semantic_limits.source_limits: Often is a slightly wider frequency than usually; retained as a qualified practical tendency. Not a claim of an attested whole Chamorro software sentence.

rows.backtranslation: Still image, at most256 colours. Dithering smooths the change from one colour to another in the image. If the GIF moves, only the first image will be opened.

rows.english: Writes plain text using light and dark characters. View it in a monospaced font. This is a visual rendition; it cannot be reopened as the original image.
rows.raw: Mafa\'tinas lisu na tinige\' ginin simbulu siha para i chångnga yan i diduk na påtti gi pinenta. Para un atan, debi na u parehu i finedda\' kada simbulu gi klåsin lettra ni un usa. Pinenta ginin tinige\' ha\' esti; ti siña mababa ta\'lu kumu i urihinåt na pinenta.
rows.display: Mafa'tinas lisu na tinige' ginin simbulu siha para i chångnga yan i diduk na påtti gi pinenta. Para un atan, debi na u parehu i finedda' kada simbulu gi klåsin lettra ni un usa. Pinenta ginin tinige' ha' esti; ti siña mababa ta'lu kumu i urihinåt na pinenta.
rows.backtranslation: Plain text is made from symbols for the light and dark parts of the image. To view it, each symbol must have equal width in the font you use. This is only a picture made from text; it cannot be reopened as the original image.
rows.caller_summary: SaveOptionsDialog101 binds ASCII_ART to this description. TextImageCodec40–55 scales to a character grid; TextImageData160–186 writes ASCII bytes selected from image brightness, with newline rows and optional inversion. TextImageCodec13–24 instead decodes Base64 raster text on input. Equal width means a font character-cell advance, not equal ink area or shape.

semantic_limits.source_limits: No claim that lisu na tinige' or the complete equal-width sentence is a published GUI term. The requirements are functionally explicit.

rows.backtranslation: Erase all of it/them. In this caller: clear all contents of the current assembly.
rows.caller_summary: AssemblyActivity.kt:101 assembly_clear invokes ImageAssembly.clear():153, which passes emptyList() to change(). ImageAssembly.kt:233-240 writes the empty list and retains prior state in undo; clear removes placed AND unplaced entries from the current assembly and tray. It does not overwrite the pixels of source images, delete external originals, or promise permanent erasure. This is distinct from ClassicPaintActivity current-canvas Clear image.

rows.english: PDF pages are rendered at 144 dpi. Text and vector objects become pixels.
rows.raw: PDF — ᏚᎦᏓᏛᎢ — ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ: 144 dpi. ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᏢᏒᎢ — ᏂᏗᎵᏍᏔᏅ: pixel — ᎦᏟᏌᏅᎯ.
rows.display: PDF — ᏚᎦᏓᏛᎢ — ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ: 144 dpi. ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᏢᏒᎢ — ᏂᏗᎵᏍᏔᏅ: pixel — ᎦᏟᏌᏅᎯ.
rows.backtranslation: PDF pages rendering:144dpi. Text and drawn shapes: results are pixel data.
rows.caller_summary: ImportSelection102 shows PDF-only page guidance before selection. PdfCodec15/21 uses two source pixels per PDF point; decode60–88 rasterizes selected PDF page/crop to ARGB8888 through page.render. Numeric144dpi matches native source-coordinate convention; final sampled resize may produce smaller dimensions. Text and vector objects are not retained as editable text/vector elements.

semantic_limits.source_limits: Vector objects are functionally described as shapes made by drawing tools (exact MS shape definition), not arbitrary photo objects. This is an explicit broader concrete paraphrase, and must be reviewed as preserving the rasterization warning. Result heading communicates change into pixels; exact borrowed pixel plus data noun avoids claiming one pixel. Rendering source is geometric rendering; extension to PDF page display is authored. No higher resolution or retained text-editability claim.

rows.confidence: moderate source-compositional nomination with explicit review-sensitive functional paraphrase

rows.raw: Mås meggai i RAM ni ha nisisita AN Paint para i pinenta yan i tempuråriu na kåmpu para u mafa\'tinas i dokumentu ki i RAM ni ha sedi para esti na che\'chu\'.

rows.backtranslation: The RAM AN Paint needs for the image and the temporary space for making the file is greater than the RAM it permits for this operation.
rows.caller_summary: BitmapFileCodec20–25/DibCodec41–43 route reason0 from LegacyImageEncoder26–30; TextImageCodec27/42/55–56 and IcoCodec78–79 explicitly compare required buffers/image to budget. ClassicPaintActivity1364 passes ImageMemoryPolicy.workingBytes for all save/export formats. This is not an OutOfMemoryError, and not limited to derived Export as or separate-copy-only operations.

semantic_limits.source_limits: Encoding buffers are temporary working space for producing the output file. No assertion of an actual completed allocation or true device-wide RAM exhaustion. Does not incorrectly promise a separate non-overwriting export because this resource also serves normal Save.
